# Repotra vendored MarkdownEngine

- Upstream: https://github.com/nodes-app/swift-markdown-engine
- Imported release: `0.9.0` (2026-07-13)
- License: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`.

The original source and tests were imported from the release archive. Repotra
keeps the package local so its Markdown extensions and compatibility fixes are
reproducible. The optional upstream LaTeX product is intentionally excluded.
